title: Move the begin-preparation failure classification out of the dispatch loop in engram_host_adapter.rs
outcome: The prepared-begin failure decision in the dispatch loop (the pending, possibly-sent and late classification, kept_pending_unsent, issued_unbegun arming, the hold note, the transient settle, and the applied-after-deadline branch) lives in helpers in engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs. engram_host_adapter.rs shrinks accordingly, and the move is a pure code move with no behaviour change.
acceptance: The classification is moved into engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs helpers that return a decision (card code, issued_unbegun arming, hold note, transient settle). The dispatch loop calls them, and engram_host_adapter.rs is smaller by the moved lines.
The move is a pure code move: no renames, no signature changes beyond the extracted helpers, and the existing begin-preparation, begin-replay and admission-retry tests pass unchanged.
